limitations: PASS covers only listed observed properties, not all CSS or pixel equality.

source.shaping: NONE: cmap glyphs with hmtx advances; no GSUB/GPOS, kerning, hinting or rasterization.

limitations: This compares paths under nonzero fill, not font renderer behavior, hinting or pixels.
Individual contour reversal, multiple native fill paths, evenodd or inexact coordinates are not certified.

vectorSurfaceComparison.membershipRule: Pixel centers; text takes priority over corner rectangles. Rectangles are not glyph or curve masks.
